environment.description: Go microservice packaged as a custom runtime Lambda function exposed via Lambda Function URL. The Function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The Lambda execution role has a resource-based policy that only grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl to principals within the same AWS Organization (condition: aws:PrincipalOrgID = o-abc123def4). There is no additional API Gateway or ALB in front. Note: the Lambda function URL endpoint is publicly resolvable (https://xxxxxxx.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/) but the IAM auth requirement means unsigned requests receive HTTP 403 from the Lambda service itself before reaching the function code. The function's resource policy does NOT include a wildcard principal allowance.
